pages.privacy.10.en: Without online play, your village stays on your device and the game sends us nothing about you (unless you turn on crash reports).
pages.privacy.10.text: Láìsí eré orí ayélujára, abúlé rẹ ń wà lórí ẹ̀rọ rẹ, eré náà kò sì fi nǹkankan nípa rẹ ránṣẹ́ sí wa (àyàfi tí o bá tan ìròyìn ìjamba).

pages.privacy.11.en: For online play we keep what the game needs: an account with a random Player ID, the name you choose, your village and battles, chat, friends and purchases.
pages.privacy.11.text: Fún eré orí ayélujára, a ń pa ohun tí eré náà nílò mọ́: àkáǹtì kan pẹ̀lú ID Òṣèré àìròtẹ́lẹ̀, orúkọ tí o yàn, abúlé rẹ àti àwọn ogun rẹ, ìjíròrò, ọ̀rẹ́ àti rírà.

pages.privacy.12.en: We do not ask for your email address, real name, contacts or location in the game. There are no ads, no tracking across other apps, and we never sell your data.
pages.privacy.12.text: A kò béèrè àdírẹ́sì ímeèlì rẹ, orúkọ gidi rẹ, àwọn olùbásọ̀rọ̀ rẹ tàbí ibi tí o wà nínú eré. Kò sí ìpolówó, kò sí títọpa rẹ káàkiri àwọn àpù mìíràn, a kì í sì í ta dátà rẹ láé.

pages.privacy.13.en: You can delete your online account in the game or on the web at any time.
pages.privacy.13.text: O lè pa àkáǹtì orí ayélujára rẹ rẹ́ nínú eré tàbí lórí wẹ́ẹ̀bù nígbàkúùgbà.

pages.privacy.14.text: Ẹgbẹ́ ọjọ́ orí àti àwọn òṣèré kékeré

pages.privacy.15.en: Kagemura is a strategy game with cartoon combat, rated for teens and up in the app stores. Before you play online, the game asks your year of birth (and the month, only when the year alone does not settle it) without suggesting an answer, or uses the age range your device's app store provides. It keeps only the resulting age group (under 13, 13 to 17, or 18 or older), not your date of birth, and uses it only to set up the game for your age:
pages.privacy.15.text: Kagemura jẹ́ eré ọgbọ́n pẹ̀lú ìjà eré àwòrán, tí a díwọ̀n fún àwọn ọ̀dọ́ àti àgbà nínú àwọn ọjà àpù. Kí o tó ṣeré lórí ayélujára, eré náà ń béèrè ọdún ìbí rẹ (àti oṣù, kìkì nígbà tí ọdún nìkan kò bá tó) láìdábàá ìdáhùn kankan, tàbí ó ń lo ìwọ̀n ọjọ́ orí tí ọjà àpù ẹ̀rọ rẹ pèsè. Ẹgbẹ́ ọjọ́ orí tí ó jáde nìkan ló ń pa mọ́ (kò tíì pé 13, 13 sí 17, tàbí 18 àti jù bẹ́ẹ̀ lọ), kì í ṣe ọjọ́ ìbí rẹ, ó sì ń lò ó kìkì láti ṣètò eré náà fún ọjọ́ orí rẹ:

pages.privacy.16.en: {t0}Under 13:{t1} no free-text chat (only a set of fixed phrases such as "Good luck!"), a generated player name instead of a chosen one, and other players cannot find you by name. You can still play, raid and join an Alliance.
pages.privacy.16.text: {t0}Kò tíì pé 13:{t1} kò sí ìjíròrò ọ̀rọ̀ òmìnira (kìkì àwọn gbólóhùn tí a ti ṣètò bí "Orí ire!"), orúkọ òṣèré tí kọ̀ǹpútà ṣe dípò èyí tí o yàn, àwọn òṣèré mìíràn kò sì lè rí ọ nípa orúkọ. O ṣì lè ṣeré, gbógun ti, kí o sì darapọ̀ mọ́ Àjọṣepọ̀.

pages.privacy.17.en: {t0}13 to 17:{t1} only friends of your friends can find you by name, and friends do not see when you were last online, until you change these in Settings.
pages.privacy.17.text: {t0}13 sí 17:{t1} kìkì ọ̀rẹ́ àwọn ọ̀rẹ́ rẹ ló lè rí ọ nípa orúkọ, àwọn ọ̀rẹ́ kò sì rí ìgbà ìkẹyìn tí o wà lórí ayélujára, títí o fi yí ìwọ̀nyí padà nínú Ètò.

pages.privacy.18.en: {t0}Under 18 (both younger groups):{t1} a monthly spending limit, an extra "check with a grown-up" step before buying, and no limited-time offers that pop up on their own.
pages.privacy.18.text: {t0}Kò tíì pé 18 (ẹgbẹ́ kékeré méjèèjì):{t1} ààlà ìnáwó oṣooṣù, ìgbésẹ̀ àfikún "bá àgbàlagbà kan sọ̀rọ̀ ná" kí o tó rà, kò sì sí ìfilọ̀ onígbà díẹ̀ tí ń yọ jáde fúnra wọn.

pages.privacy.19.en: The age group is your own statement, not age verification. Once you have said you are under 18, the game cannot switch you back to adult on its own; our support team can, after checking. If you are a parent and believe your child gave a wrong age or shared personal details, write to us and we will help, including deleting the account. These protections apply in versions of the game released with them; older versions ask the age group only before a first purchase.
pages.privacy.19.text: Ẹgbẹ́ ọjọ́ orí jẹ́ ọ̀rọ̀ tìrẹ, kì í ṣe ìfìdímúlẹ̀ ọjọ́ orí. Ní kété tí o bá ti sọ pé o kò tíì pé 18, eré náà kò lè dá ọ padà sí àgbàlagbà fúnra rẹ̀; ẹgbẹ́ ìrànlọ́wọ́ wa lè ṣe é, lẹ́yìn àyẹ̀wò. Tí o bá jẹ́ òbí tí o sì gbàgbọ́ pé ọmọ rẹ sọ ọjọ́ orí tí kò tọ́ tàbí pín àlàyé ara ẹni, kọ̀wé sí wa, a ó sì ràn ọ́ lọ́wọ́, títí kan pípa àkáǹtì rẹ́. Àwọn ààbò wọ̀nyí kan àwọn ẹ̀dà eré tí a tú jáde pẹ̀lú wọn; àwọn ẹ̀dà àtijọ́ ń béèrè ẹgbẹ́ ọjọ́ orí kìkì ṣáájú rírà àkọ́kọ́.

pages.privacy.21.en: Your village is saved on your device. The game does not need an account, and with online play off it sends nothing about you to us (unless you turn on crash reports, below). Gameplay statistics shown in Settings ("Analytics events") stay on the device, unless you are an adult playing online and choose to share them (below). If you play in a web browser, the website that delivers the game sees your IP address, as every website does.
pages.privacy.21.text: A ń fi abúlé rẹ pamọ́ sórí ẹ̀rọ rẹ. Eré náà kò nílò àkáǹtì, nígbà tí eré orí ayélujára bá sì wà ní pípa, kò fi nǹkankan nípa rẹ ránṣẹ́ sí wa (àyàfi tí o bá tan ìròyìn ìjamba, ní ìsàlẹ̀). Ìṣirò eré tí a fi hàn nínú Ètò ("Ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ ìṣirò") ń wà lórí ẹ̀rọ náà, àyàfi tí o bá jẹ́ àgbàlagbà tí ń ṣeré lórí ayélujára tí o sì yàn láti pín wọn (ní ìsàlẹ̀). Tí o bá ń ṣeré nínú aṣàwákiri wẹ́ẹ̀bù, ojú-òpó tí ń fi eré náà jíṣẹ́ ń rí àdírẹ́sì IP rẹ, bí gbogbo ojú-òpó ṣe ń rí i.

pages.privacy.22.en: What we collect, why, and on what legal basis
pages.privacy.22.text: Ohun tí a ń gbà, ìdí rẹ̀, àti ìpìlẹ̀ òfin rẹ̀

pages.privacy.23.en: The legal bases are those of the EU and UK GDPR (Art. 6) and of Brazil's LGPD (Art. 7). "Contract" means we need the data to provide the game you asked to play; "legitimate interests" means we have weighed our reason against your rights and you can object (see "Your rights").
pages.privacy.23.text: Àwọn ìpìlẹ̀ òfin náà ni ti EU àti UK GDPR (Art. 6) àti ti LGPD Brazil (Art. 7). "Àdéhùn" túmọ̀ sí pé a nílò dátà náà láti pèsè eré tí o béèrè láti ṣe; "àǹfààní tí ó tọ́" túmọ̀ sí pé a ti wọn ìdí wa pẹ̀lú ẹ̀tọ́ rẹ, o sì lè tako (wo "Ẹ̀tọ́ rẹ").

pages.privacy.24.en: Online account: random Player ID, a secret sign-in token (we store only a one-way hash), the name you choose, your friend code, your age group, your privacy choices, when you were last online
pages.privacy.24.text: Àkáǹtì orí ayélujára: ID Òṣèré àìròtẹ́lẹ̀, àmì ìwọlé àṣírí (a ń tọ́jú hash ọ̀nà-kan nìkan), orúkọ tí o yàn, kóòdù ọ̀rẹ́ rẹ, ẹgbẹ́ ọjọ́ orí rẹ, àwọn yíyàn àṣírí rẹ, ìgbà ìkẹyìn tí o wà lórí ayélujára

pages.privacy.25.en: To run your online account, show your name to other players and apply the protections for your age group. Basis: contract; for the age group also legal obligation and legitimate interests (protecting younger players). LGPD: contract performance, legal obligation.
pages.privacy.25.text: Láti ṣiṣẹ́ àkáǹtì orí ayélujára rẹ, láti fi orúkọ rẹ han àwọn òṣèré mìíràn àti láti lo ààbò fún ẹgbẹ́ ọjọ́ orí rẹ. Ìpìlẹ̀: àdéhùn; fún ẹgbẹ́ ọjọ́ orí, ojúṣe òfin àti àǹfààní tí ó tọ́ pẹ̀lú (dídáàbò bo àwọn òṣèré kékeré). LGPD: ìmúṣẹ àdéhùn, ojúṣe òfin.

pages.privacy.26.en: Your game: your base for raids, the village kept on our server and the actions you take in it, battles and replays, honor, rankings and ratings, a history of resources added or spent
pages.privacy.26.text: Eré rẹ: ibùdó rẹ fún ìgbógunti, abúlé tí a tọ́jú sórí sáfà wa àti àwọn iṣẹ́ tí o ṣe nínú rẹ̀, ogun àti àtúnwò, ọlá, ipò àti ìdíwọ̀n, ìtàn ohun-ìní tí a fi kún tàbí tí a ná

pages.privacy.27.en: So online play works, raids are checked and fair, and you can continue on another device. Basis: contract; checking battles for cheating is a legitimate interest.
pages.privacy.27.text: Kí eré orí ayélujára lè ṣiṣẹ́, kí a lè ṣàyẹ̀wò ìgbógunti kí wọ́n sì jẹ́ òdodo, kí o sì lè tẹ̀síwájú lórí ẹ̀rọ mìíràn. Ìpìlẹ̀: àdéhùn; ṣíṣàyẹ̀wò ogun fún màgòmágó jẹ́ àǹfààní tí ó tọ́.

pages.privacy.28.en: Social features: Alliance and Gang chat messages, warrior requests and gifts, friends and friend requests, Gangs, Gang Wars and Friendly Duels
pages.privacy.28.text: Àwọn ẹ̀yà àwùjọ: ọ̀rọ̀ ìjíròrò Àjọṣepọ̀ àti Ẹgbẹ́, ìbéèrè àti ẹ̀bùn jagunjagun, ọ̀rẹ́ àti ìbéèrè ọ̀rẹ́, Ẹgbẹ́, Ogun Ẹgbẹ́ àti Ìfẹ̀sọ̀jà Ọ̀rẹ́

pages.privacy.29.en: To provide these features. Basis: contract.
pages.privacy.29.text: Láti pèsè àwọn ẹ̀yà wọ̀nyí. Ìpìlẹ̀: àdéhùn.

pages.privacy.30.en: Safety: reports you make (reason, optional note and, for a chat message, its text as it was sent), blocks, mutes and suspensions, and the notices we send you about them (kept in your account until it is deleted)
pages.privacy.30.text: Ààbò: àwọn ẹ̀sùn tí o fi kàn (ìdí, àkọsílẹ̀ àṣàyàn àti, fún ọ̀rọ̀ ìjíròrò, ọ̀rọ̀ rẹ̀ bí a ṣe fi ránṣẹ́), dídí, pípa lẹ́nu mọ́ àti ìdádúró, àti àwọn ìkéde tí a fi ránṣẹ́ sí ọ nípa wọn (tí a pa mọ́ sínú àkáǹtì rẹ títí a ó fi pa á rẹ́)

pages.privacy.31.en: To keep the community safe, act on reports, tell reporters and affected players what we decided, and handle appeals. Basis: legitimate interests (a safe game for everyone) and, where online-safety laws require it, legal obligation.
pages.privacy.31.text: Láti pa àwùjọ mọ́ láìléwu, láti gbé ìgbésẹ̀ lórí ẹ̀sùn, láti sọ ohun tí a pinnu fún àwọn tí ó fi ẹ̀sùn kàn àti àwọn òṣèré tí ọ̀rọ̀ kàn, àti láti bójútó ẹ̀bẹ̀ àtúnwò. Ìpìlẹ̀: àǹfààní tí ó tọ́ (eré tí ó láàbò fún gbogbo ènìyàn) àti, níbi tí òfin ààbò orí ayélujára bá béèrè rẹ̀, ojúṣe òfin.

pages.privacy.32.en: Sign-ins you link (optional): the id that Apple, Google or Game Center gives us for you; for Sign in with Apple also the token Apple issues to the game; which sign-in each of your devices used and when it was last used
pages.privacy.32.text: Ọ̀nà ìwọlé tí o so (àṣàyàn): id tí Apple, Google tàbí Game Center fún wa fún ọ; fún Sign in with Apple, àmì tí Apple fún eré náà pẹ̀lú; ọ̀nà ìwọlé tí ẹ̀rọ rẹ kọ̀ọ̀kan lò àti ìgbà ìkẹyìn tí a lò ó

pages.privacy.33.en: To restore your account on another device, sign out devices when you unlink a sign-in, and revoke the game's access at Apple when you delete your account or unlink Apple. We never receive or keep your email address or name from them. Basis: contract, at your request.
pages.privacy.33.text: Láti dá àkáǹtì rẹ padà lórí ẹ̀rọ mìíràn, láti mú ẹ̀rọ jáde nígbà tí o bá tú ọ̀nà ìwọlé kan, àti láti fagilé ààyè eré náà ní Apple nígbà tí o bá pa àkáǹtì rẹ rẹ́ tàbí tú Apple. A kì í gba tàbí pa àdírẹ́sì ímeèlì tàbí orúkọ rẹ mọ́ láti ọ̀dọ̀ wọn láé. Ìpìlẹ̀: àdéhùn, ní ìbéèrè rẹ.

pages.privacy.34.en: Purchases: the store's transaction id, product, price, date and refund status
pages.privacy.34.text: Rírà: id ìdúnàádúrà ọjà, ọjà, iye owó, ọjọ́ àti ipò ìdápadà owó

pages.privacy.35.en: To deliver each purchase once, restore it, handle refunds and apply the under-18 limit. Basis: contract and legal obligation (tax and accounting records).
pages.privacy.35.text: Láti fi rírà kọ̀ọ̀kan jíṣẹ́ lẹ́ẹ̀kan, láti dá a padà, láti bójútó ìdápadà owó àti láti lo ààlà àwọn tí kò tíì pé 18. Ìpìlẹ̀: àdéhùn àti ojúṣe òfin (àkọsílẹ̀ owó-orí àti ìṣirò owó).

pages.privacy.36.en: Notifications (optional): your device's notification token, the types you chose and your time-zone offset
pages.privacy.36.text: Ìfitónilétí (àṣàyàn): àmì ìfitónilétí ẹ̀rọ rẹ, àwọn irú tí o yàn àti ìyàtọ̀ agbègbè àkókò rẹ

pages.privacy.37.en: To send only the notifications you switched on, never at night or too often. Basis: consent (you turn them on, and can turn them off).
pages.privacy.37.text: Láti fi àwọn ìfitónilétí tí o tàn nìkan ránṣẹ́, kì í ṣe lóru tàbí lóòrèkóòrè jù láé. Ìpìlẹ̀: ìyọ̀ǹda (o ń tàn wọ́n, o sì lè pa wọ́n).

pages.privacy.38.en: Network data: your IP address with each request to our server
pages.privacy.38.text: Dátà nẹ́tíwọ̀ọ̀kì: àdírẹ́sì IP rẹ pẹ̀lú ìbéèrè kọ̀ọ̀kan sí sáfà wa

pages.privacy.39.en: To stop abuse (rate limits) and keep the service secure. Kept only in short-lived counters and in server logs. We do not use it to work out where you are. Basis: legitimate interests (security).
pages.privacy.39.text: Láti dá ìlòkulò dúró (ààlà ìyára) àti láti pa iṣẹ́ náà mọ́ láìléwu. A ń pa á mọ́ kìkì nínú àwọn akàwé onígbà kúkúrú àti nínú àkọsílẹ̀ sáfà. A kì í lò ó láti mọ ibi tí o wà. Ìpìlẹ̀: àǹfààní tí ó tọ́ (ààbò).

pages.privacy.40.en: Server error reports: the error, the route, and the request method and path (no query strings or request contents)
pages.privacy.40.text: Ìròyìn àṣìṣe sáfà: àṣìṣe náà, ọ̀nà náà, àti ọ̀nà àti ipa ọ̀nà ìbéèrè (kò sí query string tàbí ohun inú ìbéèrè)

pages.privacy.41.en: To fix faults in our server. Basis: legitimate interests.
pages.privacy.41.text: Láti tún àṣìṣe ṣe nínú sáfà wa. Ìpìlẹ̀: àǹfààní tí ó tọ́.

pages.privacy.42.en: Crash reports from the game (optional, below)
pages.privacy.42.text: Ìròyìn ìjamba láti inú eré (àṣàyàn, ní ìsàlẹ̀)

pages.privacy.43.text: Láti tún ìjamba ṣe. Ìpìlẹ̀: ìyọ̀ǹda.

pages.privacy.44.en: Play statistics (optional, adults only, below): what you do in the game under a random statistics id
pages.privacy.44.text: Ìṣirò eré (àṣàyàn, àgbàlagbà nìkan, ní ìsàlẹ̀): ohun tí o ń ṣe nínú eré lábẹ́ id ìṣirò àìròtẹ́lẹ̀

pages.privacy.45.en: To see where players get stuck and whether changes help. Basis: consent.
pages.privacy.45.text: Láti rí ibi tí àwọn òṣèré ti ń há àti bóyá àwọn àyípadà ń ṣèrànwọ́. Ìpìlẹ̀: ìyọ̀ǹda.

pages.privacy.46.en: Support email and web deletion requests
pages.privacy.46.text: Ímeèlì ìrànlọ́wọ́ àti ìbéèrè ìparẹ́ lórí wẹ́ẹ̀bù

pages.privacy.47.en: To answer you and carry out your request, and to keep a record that we did. Basis: legitimate interests; for deletion requests, legal obligation.
pages.privacy.47.text: Láti dá ọ lóhùn àti láti ṣe ohun tí o béèrè, àti láti pa àkọsílẹ̀ mọ́ pé a ṣe é. Ìpìlẹ̀: àǹfààní tí ó tọ́; fún ìbéèrè ìparẹ́, ojúṣe òfin.

pages.privacy.48.en: If you ask the game to find your Game Center friends, we use their ids once to see which of them play Kagemura; we do not keep that list. We do not make decisions about you by automated means that have legal or similarly significant effects. One automatic safety step exists: a chat message reported by three different players is hidden until our staff look at it.
pages.privacy.48.text: Tí o bá ní kí eré náà wá àwọn ọ̀rẹ́ Game Center rẹ, a ń lo id wọn lẹ́ẹ̀kan láti rí èwo nínú wọn tí ń ṣe Kagemura; a kò pa àtòjọ yẹn mọ́. A kì í ṣe ìpinnu nípa rẹ nípasẹ̀ ẹ̀rọ aládàáṣiṣẹ́ tí ó ní ipa òfin tàbí ipa pàtàkì bẹ́ẹ̀. Ìgbésẹ̀ ààbò aládàáṣiṣẹ́ kan wà: ọ̀rọ̀ ìjíròrò tí òṣèré mẹ́ta ọ̀tọ̀ọ̀tọ̀ fi ẹ̀sùn kàn ni a ń fi pamọ́ títí àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ wa yóò fi wò ó.

pages.privacy.49.en: Play statistics (off unless you say yes; adults only)
pages.privacy.49.text: Ìṣirò eré (ó wà ní pípa àyàfi tí o bá gbà; àgbàlagbà nìkan)

pages.privacy.50.en: When you play online and have told us you are an adult, the game asks once whether you want to share play statistics; Settings has the same switch. It is off until you say yes, and the game never asks, or sends statistics, for players under 18 or whose age it does not know. When it is on, the game sends what you do in the game (sessions starting, tutorial steps, raids with their stars and destruction, upgrades and research started, offers shown, Jade spent on speed-ups and purchases with their product and price) under a random statistics id made for this purpose. The statistics id is not your Player ID and is never sent together with it; the game does not add your name, village, chat or sign-in token, and our server does not store the IP address with them. Saying yes also sends what this device recorded before (so we can see the first minutes of play). Turning the switch off deletes what that statistics id sent; saying yes again starts a new one. We keep shared statistics for 400 days and use them only in totals (for example, how many new players came back the next day). Players who share may receive slightly different timings for in-game offers, to compare which works better; prices, rewards and game rules are the same for everyone.
pages.privacy.50.text: Nígbà tí o bá ń ṣeré lórí ayélujára tí o sì ti sọ fún wa pé o jẹ́ àgbàlagbà, eré náà ń béèrè lẹ́ẹ̀kan bóyá o fẹ́ pín ìṣirò eré; Ètò ní ìyípadà kan náà. Ó wà ní pípa títí o fi gbà, eré náà kì í sì í béèrè, tàbí fi ìṣirò ránṣẹ́, fún àwọn òṣèré tí kò tíì pé 18 tàbí tí a kò mọ ọjọ́ orí wọn. Nígbà tí ó bá wà ní títàn, eré náà ń fi ohun tí o ń ṣe nínú eré ránṣẹ́ (ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ ìgbà eré, ìgbésẹ̀ ẹ̀kọ́, ìgbógunti pẹ̀lú ìràwọ̀ àti ìparun wọn, àgbéga àti ìwádìí tí a bẹ̀rẹ̀, ìfilọ̀ tí a fi hàn, Jéèdì tí a ná lórí ìmúyára àti rírà pẹ̀lú ọjà àti iye owó wọn) lábẹ́ id ìṣirò àìròtẹ́lẹ̀ tí a ṣe fún èyí. Id ìṣirò kì í ṣe ID Òṣèré rẹ, a kì í sì í fi wọ́n ránṣẹ́ pọ̀ láé; eré náà kò fi orúkọ rẹ, abúlé rẹ, ìjíròrò rẹ tàbí àmì ìwọlé rẹ kún un, sáfà wa kò sì tọ́jú àdírẹ́sì IP pẹ̀lú wọn. Gbígbà tún ń fi ohun tí ẹ̀rọ yìí ti kọ sílẹ̀ tẹ́lẹ̀ ránṣẹ́ (kí a lè rí ìṣẹ́jú àkọ́kọ́ eré). Pípa ìyípadà náà ń pa ohun tí id ìṣirò yẹn fi ránṣẹ́ rẹ́; gbígbà lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí i ń bẹ̀rẹ̀ tuntun. A ń pa ìṣirò tí a pín mọ́ fún ọjọ́ 400, a sì ń lò wọ́n kìkì ní àròpọ̀ (fún àpẹẹrẹ, iye òṣèré tuntun tí ó padà wá ní ọjọ́ kejì). Àwọn òṣèré tí ń pín lè gba àkókò ìfilọ̀ inú eré tí ó yàtọ̀ díẹ̀, láti fi wé èyí tí ó ṣiṣẹ́ dáadáa jù; iye owó, ẹ̀bùn àti òfin eré jẹ́ bákan náà fún gbogbo ènìyàn.

pages.privacy.51.en: Crash reports (off unless you turn them on)
pages.privacy.51.text: Ìròyìn ìjamba (ó wà ní pípa àyàfi tí o bá tàn án)

pages.privacy.52.en: Versions of the game that include crash reporting show a "Send crash reports" switch in Settings. It is off until you turn it on. When it is on and the game hits an error, the game sends the error message, where in the game's code it happened, the game version and the platform to our error-tracking service (Sentry). The game does not attach your name, Player ID, village, chat or save, and removes web-address parameters and anything shaped like an email address from the message. An error message can still occasionally include text the game was working on when it failed. The service sees the IP address the report comes from; we set the service not to store IP addresses. Turning the switch off stops new reports at once.
pages.privacy.52.text: Àwọn ẹ̀dà eré tí ó ní ìròyìn ìjamba ń fi ìyípadà "Fi ìròyìn ìjamba ránṣẹ́" hàn nínú Ètò. Ó wà ní pípa títí o fi tàn án. Nígbà tí ó bá wà ní títàn tí eré náà sì ní àṣìṣe, eré náà ń fi ọ̀rọ̀ àṣìṣe náà, ibi tí ó ti ṣẹlẹ̀ nínú kóòdù eré, ẹ̀dà eré àti pẹpẹ náà ránṣẹ́ sí iṣẹ́ ìtọpa àṣìṣe wa (Sentry). Eré náà kò so orúkọ rẹ, ID Òṣèré rẹ, abúlé rẹ, ìjíròrò rẹ tàbí ìfipamọ́ rẹ mọ́ ọn, ó sì ń yọ àwọn àpèjúwe àdírẹ́sì wẹ́ẹ̀bù àti ohunkóhun tí ó jọ àdírẹ́sì ímeèlì kúrò nínú ọ̀rọ̀ náà. Ọ̀rọ̀ àṣìṣe ṣì lè ní ọ̀rọ̀ tí eré ń ṣiṣẹ́ lé lórí nígbà tí ó kùnà nígbà mìíràn. Iṣẹ́ náà ń rí àdírẹ́sì IP tí ìròyìn náà ti wá; a ṣètò iṣẹ́ náà láti má ṣe tọ́jú àdírẹ́sì IP. Pípa ìyípadà náà ń dá ìròyìn tuntun dúró lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀.

pages.privacy.54.en: When you report a message or a player, our staff review it and can remove the message, mute chat or suspend the account (see the {t0}community rules{t1}). We tell the player who reported what happened, and we tell a player when we remove their message, mute them or suspend them, with the reason and how to appeal. We do not tell a reported player who reported them. Every staff action is logged so that decisions can be checked.
pages.privacy.54.text: Nígbà tí o bá fi ẹ̀sùn kan ọ̀rọ̀ kan tàbí òṣèré kan, àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ wa ń ṣàyẹ̀wò rẹ̀, wọ́n sì lè yọ ọ̀rọ̀ náà kúrò, pa ìjíròrò lẹ́nu mọ́ tàbí dá àkáǹtì dúró (wo {t0}òfin àwùjọ{t1}). A ń sọ ohun tí ó ṣẹlẹ̀ fún òṣèré tí ó fi ẹ̀sùn kàn, a sì ń sọ fún òṣèré kan nígbà tí a bá yọ ọ̀rọ̀ rẹ̀ kúrò, pa á lẹ́nu mọ́ tàbí dá a dúró, pẹ̀lú ìdí àti bí a ṣe lè bẹ̀bẹ̀ àtúnwò. A kì í sọ ẹni tí ó fi ẹ̀sùn kan òṣèré kan fún un. A ń kọ gbogbo ìgbésẹ̀ òṣìṣẹ́ sílẹ̀ kí a lè ṣàyẹ̀wò àwọn ìpinnu.

pages.privacy.55.text: Nígbà tí o bá kàn sí wa

pages.privacy.57.en: {t0}Web deletion requests.{t1} The account deletion page asks for your Player ID, the deletion code the game gives you, and an optional note. It does not ask for an email address. We keep the request and what we did about it as a record that it was handled.
pages.privacy.57.text: {t0}Ìbéèrè ìparẹ́ lórí wẹ́ẹ̀bù.{t1} Ojú-ìwé ìparẹ́ àkáǹtì ń béèrè ID Òṣèré rẹ, kóòdù ìparẹ́ tí eré fún ọ, àti àkọsílẹ̀ àṣàyàn. Kò béèrè àdírẹ́sì ímeèlì. A ń pa ìbéèrè náà àti ohun tí a ṣe nípa rẹ̀ mọ́ bí àkọsílẹ̀ pé a bójútó o.

pages.privacy.58.text: Ohun tí a kì í ṣe

pages.privacy.59.en: We do not ask for your email address in the game, and we do not collect your contacts, precise location, photos or advertising id. There are no ads and no third-party tracking, and we do not sell your data or share it for advertising or cross-context behavioural advertising.
pages.privacy.59.text: A kì í béèrè àdírẹ́sì ímeèlì rẹ nínú eré, a kì í sì í gba àwọn olùbásọ̀rọ̀ rẹ, ibi tí o wà gangan, fọ́tò tàbí id ìpolówó rẹ. Kò sí ìpolówó, kò sí títọpa láti ọwọ́ ẹnìkẹta, a kì í sì í ta dátà rẹ tàbí pín in fún ìpolówó tàbí ìpolówó ìhùwàsí oníàyíká-púpọ̀.

pages.privacy.60.text: Ta ló ń ṣiṣẹ́ lé e lórí, àti níbo

pages.privacy.61.en: We use service providers who process data only on our instructions: our hosting provider (server and database: {t0}{t1}), our error-tracking service Sentry (crash reports only if you turn them on, and our server's own errors; data region: {t2}{t3}), and Apple and Google (sign-in, purchases and notifications, under their own privacy policies). Our staff see what they need to answer support and moderate.
pages.privacy.61.text: A ń lo àwọn olùpèsè iṣẹ́ tí ń ṣiṣẹ́ lórí dátà kìkì gẹ́gẹ́ bí àṣẹ wa: olùpèsè ibùgbé wa (sáfà àti ibi ìpamọ́ dátà: {t0}{t1}), iṣẹ́ ìtọpa àṣìṣe wa Sentry (ìròyìn ìjamba kìkì tí o bá tàn án, àti àṣìṣe sáfà wa fúnra rẹ̀; agbègbè dátà: {t2}{t3}), àti Apple àti Google (ìwọlé, rírà àti ìfitónilétí, lábẹ́ ìlànà àṣírí tiwọn). Àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ wa ń rí ohun tí wọ́n nílò láti dáhùn ìrànlọ́wọ́ àti láti bójútó.

pages.privacy.62.en: Some of these providers may process data outside your country, including outside the EU, UK or Brazil. Where data leaves the EU or UK for a country without an adequacy decision, we rely on the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses (and the UK addendum or International Data Transfer Agreement) or another transfer mechanism the law allows. You can ask us for a copy of the safeguards.
pages.privacy.62.text: Díẹ̀ nínú àwọn olùpèsè wọ̀nyí lè ṣiṣẹ́ lórí dátà ní ẹ̀yìn orílẹ̀-èdè rẹ, títí kan ẹ̀yìn EU, UK tàbí Brazil. Níbi tí dátà bá kúrò ní EU tàbí UK lọ sí orílẹ̀-èdè tí kò ní ìpinnu ìtẹ́lọ́rùn, a gbára lé Àwọn Àpilẹ̀kọ Àdéhùn Àjùmọ̀lò ti European Commission (àti àfikún UK tàbí Àdéhùn Ìgbéjáde Dátà Àgbáyé) tàbí ọ̀nà ìgbéjáde mìíràn tí òfin gbà láàyè. O lè béèrè ẹ̀dà àwọn ààbò náà lọ́wọ́ wa.

pages.privacy.63.text: Bí a ṣe ń pa á mọ́ pẹ́ tó

pages.privacy.64.text: Àkáǹtì orí ayélujára rẹ àti ohun tí ó jẹ́ tirẹ̀: níwọ̀n ìgbà tí àkáǹtì náà bá wà. Àwọn àkáǹtì tí a kò lò lórí ayélujára fún {t0}{t1} ni a ń pa rẹ́ lẹ́yìn ìkéde nínú eré.

pages.privacy.65.text: Àtúnwò ogun àti Ìfẹ̀sọ̀jà Ọ̀rẹ́: ọjọ́ 30. Iṣẹ́ abúlé ọjọ́ 30 tó kẹ́yìn lórí sáfà wa: ọjọ́ 30.

pages.privacy.75.en: {t0}On the web, if you can no longer open the game:{t1} {t2}{t3}. Enter your Player ID and a deletion code: ask for one in Settings → Online play → Account while you still have the game (it works once and for 30 days; asking again replaces it, and we keep only a one-way hash of it). With the code we carry the request out; without it, we first have to make sure the request comes from the account's owner, because Player IDs and names are visible to other players. We carry out requests within 30 days.
pages.privacy.75.text: {t0}Lórí wẹ́ẹ̀bù, tí o kò bá lè ṣí eré náà mọ́:{t1} {t2}{t3}. Pẹ̀lú kóòdù náà, a ń ṣe ìbéèrè náà; láìsí i, a ní láti kọ́kọ́ rí i dájú pé ìbéèrè náà wá láti ọ̀dọ̀ ẹni tó ni àkáǹtì náà, nítorí pé àwọn òṣèré mìíràn ń rí ID Òṣèré àti orúkọ. A ń ṣe àwọn ìbéèrè láàrin ọjọ́ 30.

pages.privacy.76.en: Deleting removes your online account, name, base, chat messages, friends, Gang membership, reports you made, linked sign-ins and the village kept on our server. If you linked Sign in with Apple, we also ask Apple to revoke the game's access. Raids you made stay in other players' replays as "Deleted player"; purchase records stay without your Player ID (above).
pages.privacy.76.text: Pípa rẹ́ ń yọ àkáǹtì orí ayélujára rẹ, orúkọ rẹ, ibùdó rẹ, ọ̀rọ̀ ìjíròrò, ọ̀rẹ́, ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ Ẹgbẹ́, ẹ̀sùn tí o fi kàn, ọ̀nà ìwọlé tí o so àti abúlé tí a tọ́jú sórí sáfà wa kúrò. Tí o bá so Sign in with Apple, a tún ń ní kí Apple fagilé ààyè eré náà. Àwọn ìgbógunti tí o ṣe ń wà nínú àtúnwò àwọn òṣèré mìíràn bí "Òṣèré tí a pa rẹ́"; àkọsílẹ̀ rírà ń wà láìsí ID Òṣèré rẹ (lókè).

pages.privacy.77.en: {t0}Your village on the device{t1} is removed by uninstalling the app or clearing the site's data in your browser; Settings → "Start a new village" replaces it.
pages.privacy.77.text: {t0}Abúlé rẹ lórí ẹ̀rọ{t1} ni a ń yọ kúrò nípa yíyọ àpù náà kúrò tàbí pípa dátà ojú-òpó náà rẹ́ nínú aṣàwákiri rẹ; Ètò → "Bẹ̀rẹ̀ abúlé tuntun" ń rọ́pò rẹ̀.

pages.privacy.79.text: Ibikíbi tí o ń gbé, o lè béèrè pé kí a:

pages.privacy.81.text: {t0}ṣe àtúnṣe{t1} rẹ̀, tàbí {t2}pa á rẹ́{t3} (wo lókè);

pages.privacy.82.en: {t0}restrict{t1} how we use it while a question is being settled, and {t2}object{t3} to uses based on legitimate interests;
pages.privacy.82.text: {t0}dín{t1} bí a ṣe ń lò ó kù nígbà tí a ń yanjú ìbéèrè kan, kí o sì {t2}tako{t3} ìlò tí ó dá lórí àǹfààní tí ó tọ́;

pages.privacy.83.en: {t0}withdraw consent{t1} at any time (crash reports, play statistics, notifications: Settings), without affecting what happened before. Turning play statistics off also deletes what was shared.
pages.privacy.83.text: {t0}fa ìyọ̀ǹda sẹ́yìn{t1} nígbàkúùgbà (ìròyìn ìjamba, ìṣirò eré, ìfitónilétí: Ètò), láìkan ohun tí ó ti ṣẹlẹ̀ tẹ́lẹ̀. Pípa ìṣirò eré tún ń pa ohun tí a ti pín rẹ́.

pages.privacy.84.en: Write to {t0}{t1} with your Player ID. We answer within one month (in Brazil, within the time the LGPD sets; in California, within 45 days) and may need to confirm the account is yours first. You can also complain to a data protection authority: in the EU the authority where you live or work, in the UK the Information Commissioner's Office (ico.org.uk), in Brazil the ANPD (gov.br/anpd). Residents of California have the rights of the CCPA/CPRA, including to know, delete, correct and not be discriminated against for using them; we do not sell or share personal information as those laws define it. Under the LGPD you can also ask for confirmation that we process your data, anonymisation, information about whom we share it with, and the consequences of refusing consent.
pages.privacy.84.text: Kọ̀wé sí {t0}{t1} pẹ̀lú ID Òṣèré rẹ. A ń dáhùn láàrin oṣù kan (ní Brazil, láàrin àkókò tí LGPD fi lélẹ̀; ní California, láàrin ọjọ́ 45), a sì lè nílò láti kọ́kọ́ fìdí rẹ̀ múlẹ̀ pé àkáǹtì náà jẹ́ tìrẹ. O tún lè fi ẹ̀sùn sùn sí aláṣẹ ààbò dátà: ní EU, aláṣẹ ibi tí o ń gbé tàbí ṣiṣẹ́, ní UK, Information Commissioner's Office (ico.org.uk), ní Brazil, ANPD (gov.br/anpd). Àwọn olùgbé California ní ẹ̀tọ́ CCPA/CPRA, títí kan láti mọ̀, láti pa rẹ́, láti ṣe àtúnṣe àti láti má ṣe ṣe ẹ̀tanú sí wọn fún lílò wọ́n; a kì í ta tàbí pín àlàyé ara ẹni bí àwọn òfin yẹn ṣe ṣàlàyé rẹ̀. Lábẹ́ LGPD, o tún lè béèrè ìfìdímúlẹ̀ pé a ń ṣiṣẹ́ lórí dátà rẹ, àìdámọ̀, àlàyé nípa àwọn tí a ń pín in pẹ̀lú, àti àbájáde kíkọ ìyọ̀ǹda.

pages.privacy.86.en: Purchases are made through the App Store or Google Play. They handle your payment details; we never see them. The {t0}terms of service{t1} describe Jade and other purchases.
pages.privacy.86.text: A ń ṣe rírà nípasẹ̀ App Store tàbí Google Play. Àwọn ló ń bójútó àlàyé ìsanwó rẹ; a kì í rí wọn láé. {t0}Òfin ìlò{t1} ṣàpèjúwe Jéèdì àti àwọn rírà mìíràn.

pages.privacy.88.en: The game talks to our server only over encrypted connections (HTTPS), sign-in tokens are stored as one-way hashes, and staff access is limited and logged. No system is perfectly secure; if a breach affects you, we will tell you and the authorities as the law requires.
pages.privacy.88.text: Eré náà ń bá sáfà wa sọ̀rọ̀ kìkì nípasẹ̀ ìsopọ̀ tí a pa láróko (HTTPS), a ń tọ́jú àmì ìwọlé bí hash ọ̀nà-kan, ààyè àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ sì ní ààlà, a sì ń kọ ọ́ sílẹ̀. Kò sí ètò tí ó ní ààbò pípé; tí ìjàǹbá ààbò bá kàn ọ́, a ó sọ fún ìwọ àti àwọn aláṣẹ gẹ́gẹ́ bí òfin ṣe béèrè.

pages.privacy.90.en: We update this page and its date when what we collect changes, and tell players in the game about important changes.
pages.privacy.90.text: A ń ṣe àtúnṣe ojú-ìwé yìí àti ọjọ́ rẹ̀ nígbà tí ohun tí a ń gbà bá yí padà, a sì ń sọ fún àwọn òṣèré nínú eré nípa àwọn àyípadà pàtàkì.

pages.support.6.en: If you play online, include your Player ID (Settings → Online play → Account) and, for a purchase, the date and the store's order number. Never send your save code or anyone's password.
pages.support.6.text: Tí o bá ń ṣeré lórí ayélujára, fi ID Òṣèré rẹ kún un (Ètò → Eré orí ayélujára → Àkáǹtì) àti, fún rírà, ọjọ́ àti nọ́mbà àṣẹ ọjà náà. Má ṣe fi kóòdù ìfipamọ́ rẹ tàbí ọ̀rọ̀ aṣínà ẹnikẹ́ni ránṣẹ́ láé.

pages.support.7.en: My village is gone or looks wrong
pages.support.7.text: Abúlé mi ti sọnù tàbí kò rí bí ó ṣe yẹ

pages.support.8.en: Your village is saved on this device. If the game could not read a save, it keeps it: look for {t0}Earlier villages{t1} in Settings and tap Restore.
pages.support.8.text: A ti fi abúlé rẹ pamọ́ sórí ẹ̀rọ yìí. Tí eré náà kò bá lè ka ìfipamọ́ kan, ó ń pa á mọ́: wá {t0}Àwọn abúlé àtẹ̀yìnwá{t1} nínú Ètò kí o sì tẹ Dá a padà.

pages.support.9.en: To move a village to another device, use Settings → {t0}Copy save code{t1} on the old device and {t2}Load from code{t3} on the new one. A village kept on our server comes back when you sign in on the new device with a sign-in you linked (Settings → Online play → Account → Sign-ins).
pages.support.9.text: Láti gbé abúlé lọ sí ẹ̀rọ mìíràn, lo Ètò → {t0}Da kóòdù ìfipamọ́ kọ{t1} lórí ẹ̀rọ àtijọ́ àti {t2}Ṣí láti kóòdù{t3} lórí tuntun. Abúlé tí a tọ́jú sórí sáfà wa ń padà wá nígbà tí o bá wọlé sórí ẹ̀rọ tuntun pẹ̀lú ọ̀nà ìwọlé tí o so (Ètò → Eré orí ayélujára → Àkáǹtì → Ọ̀nà ìwọlé).

pages.support.10.en: If the game says the village is {t0}open somewhere else{t1}, close the other tab or app: only the one opened last saves.
pages.support.10.text: Tí eré náà bá sọ pé abúlé náà {t0}wà ní ṣíṣí níbòmíràn{t1}, ti táàbù tàbí àpù kejì: èyí tí a ṣí kẹ́yìn nìkan ló ń fi pamọ́.

pages.support.12.en: If a purchase did not arrive, open the Store and tap {t0}Restore purchases{t1} while online. A purchase waiting for a parent's approval or the store arrives when it is approved.
pages.support.12.text: Tí rírà kan kò bá dé, ṣí Ọjà kí o sì tẹ {t0}Dá àwọn rírà padà{t1} nígbà tí o wà lórí ayélujára. Rírà tí ń dúró de ìfọwọ́sí òbí tàbí ọjà yóò dé nígbà tí a bá fọwọ́ sí i.

pages.support.13.en: Refunds are handled by Apple or Google: ask them through your App Store or Google Play purchase history. When a store refunds a purchase, what it gave can be taken back from a village kept on our server.
pages.support.13.text: Apple tàbí Google ló ń bójútó ìdápadà owó: béèrè lọ́wọ́ wọn nípasẹ̀ ìtàn rírà App Store tàbí Google Play rẹ. Nígbà tí ọjà kan bá dá owó rírà padà, a lè gba ohun tí ó fúnni padà láti abúlé tí a tọ́jú sórí sáfà wa.

pages.support.14.en: Players under 18 have a monthly spending limit. If you said you are under 18 by mistake, write to us with your Player ID: the game cannot switch back to adult on its own.
pages.support.14.text: Àwọn òṣèré tí kò tíì pé 18 ní ààlà ìnáwó oṣooṣù. Tí o bá sọ pé o kò tíì pé 18 ní àṣìṣe, kọ̀wé sí wa pẹ̀lú ID Òṣèré rẹ: eré náà kò lè dá ọ padà sí àgbàlagbà fúnra rẹ̀.

pages.support.15.en: The web version of the game sells nothing.
pages.support.15.text: Ẹ̀dà wẹ́ẹ̀bù eré náà kò ta nǹkankan.

pages.support.16.en: Jade has no cash value and does not expire; see the {t0}terms of service{t1}. For players in Japan: {t2}特定商取引法に基づく表記{t3} · {t4}資金決済法に基づく表示{t5}.
pages.support.16.text: Jéèdì kò ní iye owó gidi, kì í sì í parí; wo {t0}òfin ìlò{t1}. Fún àwọn òṣèré ní Japan: {t2}特定商取引法に基づく表記{t3} · {t4}資金決済法に基づく表示{t5}.

pages.support.18.en: {t0}No connection{t1}: you can keep building; if your village is kept on our server, the game keeps your actions and sends them when you are back online. Raids on real players, Alliances, friends and purchases need a connection.
pages.support.18.text: {t0}Kò sí ìsopọ̀{t1}: o lè máa kọ́lé lọ; tí a bá ń tọ́jú abúlé rẹ sórí sáfà wa, eré náà ń pa àwọn iṣẹ́ rẹ mọ́, ó sì ń fi wọ́n ránṣẹ́ nígbà tí o bá padà sórí ayélujára. Ìgbógunti sí àwọn òṣèré gidi, Àjọṣepọ̀, ọ̀rẹ́ àti rírà nílò ìsopọ̀.

pages.support.19.en: {t0}Update needed{t1}: install the latest version from your store, or reload the web page.
pages.support.19.text: {t0}A nílò àtúnṣe{t1}: fi ẹ̀dà tuntun jùlọ sórí ẹ̀rọ láti ọjà rẹ, tàbí tún ojú-ìwé wẹ́ẹ̀bù náà ṣí.

pages.support.20.en: {t0}Suspended or muted{t1}: the account broke the {t2}community rules{t3}. The game tells you why and for how long. To appeal, write to us with your Player ID within six months: someone who did not take the first decision looks at it again.
pages.support.20.text: {t0}A dá a dúró tàbí a pa á lẹ́nu mọ́{t1}: àkáǹtì náà rú {t2}òfin àwùjọ{t3}. Eré náà ń sọ ìdí àti bí ó ṣe pẹ́ tó fún ọ. Láti bẹ̀bẹ̀ àtúnwò, kọ̀wé sí wa pẹ̀lú ID Òṣèré rẹ láàrin oṣù mẹ́fà: ẹni tí kò ṣe ìpinnu àkọ́kọ́ yóò tún un wò.

pages.support.21.en: {t0}Age group{t1}: the game asks a year of birth once before online play and keeps only the age group. Players under 13 chat only with fixed phrases, get a generated name and cannot be found by name; players aged 13 to 17 start hidden from strangers with their online status off. The game can only make the age group stricter; parents, write to us if your child gave a wrong age.
pages.support.21.text: {t0}Ẹgbẹ́ ọjọ́ orí{t1}: eré náà ń béèrè ọdún ìbí lẹ́ẹ̀kan ṣáájú eré orí ayélujára, ó sì ń pa ẹgbẹ́ ọjọ́ orí nìkan mọ́. Àwọn òṣèré tí kò tíì pé 13 ń bára sọ̀rọ̀ kìkì pẹ̀lú gbólóhùn tí a ti ṣètò, wọ́n ń gba orúkọ tí kọ̀ǹpútà ṣe, a kò sì lè rí wọn nípa orúkọ; àwọn òṣèré ọmọ ọdún 13 sí 17 ń bẹ̀rẹ̀ ní fífarapamọ́ fún àjèjì pẹ̀lú ipò orí ayélujára wọn ní pípa. Eré náà lè mú ẹgbẹ́ ọjọ́ orí le sí i nìkan; ẹ̀yin òbí, ẹ kọ̀wé sí wa tí ọmọ yín bá sọ ọjọ́ orí tí kò tọ́.

pages.support.23.en: Tap {t0}⋯{t1} next to their message in Alliance or Gang chat, in the Alliance member list or on a friend card to {t2}Report{t3} or {t4}Block{t5} them. Blocking hides their chat and requests from you at once. We tell you what we decided about your report, and we never tell the other player who reported them. See the {t6}community rules{t7}. If someone is in danger, contact your local emergency services first.
pages.support.23.text: Tẹ {t0}⋯{t1} lẹ́gbẹ̀ẹ́ ọ̀rọ̀ wọn nínú ìjíròrò Àjọṣepọ̀ tàbí Ẹgbẹ́, nínú àtòjọ ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ Àjọṣepọ̀ tàbí lórí káàdì ọ̀rẹ́ láti {t2}Fi ẹ̀sùn kàn{t3} tàbí {t4}Dí{t5} wọn. Dídí ń fi ìjíròrò àti ìbéèrè wọn pamọ́ fún ọ lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀. A ń sọ ohun tí a pinnu nípa ẹ̀sùn rẹ fún ọ, a kì í sì í sọ ẹni tí ó fi ẹ̀sùn kan òṣèré kejì fún un láé. Wo {t6}òfin àwùjọ{t7}. Tí ẹnìkan bá wà nínú ewu, kọ́kọ́ kàn sí iṣẹ́ pàjáwìrì agbègbè rẹ.

pages.support.25.en: In the game: Settings → Online play → Account → {t0}Delete online account{t1}. Without the game: {t2}{t3}, with your Player ID or name and a {t4}deletion code{t5}: get one in Settings → Online play → Account while you still have the game (it works once, for 30 days). Without a code we first have to check the account is yours. Your village on the device goes when you uninstall the app or clear the site's data. Details are in the {t6}privacy policy{t7}.
pages.support.25.text: Nínú eré: Ètò → Eré orí ayélujára → Àkáǹtì → {t0}Pa àkáǹtì orí ayélujára rẹ́{t1}. Láìsí eré náà: {t2}{t3}, pẹ̀lú ID Òṣèré rẹ tàbí orúkọ rẹ àti {t4}kóòdù ìparẹ́{t5}: gba ọ̀kan ní Ètò → Eré orí ayélujára → Àkáǹtì nígbà tí o ṣì ní eré náà (ó ń ṣiṣẹ́ lẹ́ẹ̀kan, fún ọjọ́ 30). Láìsí kóòdù, a ní láti kọ́kọ́ ṣàyẹ̀wò pé àkáǹtì náà jẹ́ tìrẹ. Abúlé rẹ lórí ẹ̀rọ ń lọ nígbà tí o bá yọ àpù náà kúrò tàbí pa dátà ojú-òpó náà rẹ́. Kúlẹ̀kúlẹ̀ wà nínú {t6}ìlànà àṣírí{t7}.

pages.community.2.text: Kagemura: Ìdílé Ninja · fún orúkọ òṣèré, ìjíròrò Àjọṣepọ̀ àti Ẹgbẹ́, ọ̀rẹ́, ìbéèrè jagunjagun àti ogun orí ayélujára

pages.community.4.en: Kagemura is a game for a general audience, played by people of many ages, countries and languages. By using online play you agree to these rules. Breaking them can get messages removed, chat muted or an account suspended.
pages.community.4.text: Kagemura jẹ́ eré fún gbogbo ènìyàn, tí àwọn ènìyàn onírúurú ọjọ́ orí, orílẹ̀-èdè àti èdè ń ṣe. Nípa lílo eré orí ayélujára, o gbà sí àwọn òfin wọ̀nyí. Rírú wọn lè mú kí a yọ ọ̀rọ̀ kúrò, pa ìjíròrò lẹ́nu mọ́ tàbí dá àkáǹtì dúró.

pages.community.5.en: These rules are part of the {t0}{t1}.
pages.community.5.text: Àwọn òfin wọ̀nyí jẹ́ apá kan {t0}{t1}.

pages.community.7.en: No harassment, bullying, threats or hate, in any language, spelling or code word.
pages.community.7.text: Kò sí ìyọlẹ́nu, ìfòòró, ìhalẹ̀ tàbí ìkórìíra, ní èdè, àkọtọ́ tàbí ọ̀rọ̀ àmì èyíkéyìí.

pages.community.8.en: No sexual content, and nothing that sexualises or endangers children.
pages.community.8.text: Kò sí ohun ìbálòpọ̀, kò sì sí ohunkóhun tí ó ń fi ìbálòpọ̀ hàn nípa àwọn ọmọdé tàbí tí ó ń fi wọ́n sínú ewu.

pages.community.9.en: No names that insult, impersonate another player, staff or a real person, or pretend to be official.
pages.community.9.text: Kò sí orúkọ tí ó ń bú ènìyàn, tí ó ń díbọ́n bí òṣèré mìíràn, òṣìṣẹ́ tàbí ènìyàn gidi, tàbí tí ó ń díbọ́n bí ti ìjọba.

pages.community.10.en: No spam, advertising, scams, or links to cheats.
pages.community.10.text: Kò sí àwúrúju, ìpolówó, jìbìtì, tàbí ìtọ́ka sí màgòmágó.

pages.community.11.en: Do not share personal details: yours or anyone else's (real name, address, phone, school, social accounts). Never ask other players for them.
pages.community.11.text: Má ṣe pín àlàyé ara ẹni: tìrẹ tàbí ti ẹnikẹ́ni mìíràn (orúkọ gidi, àdírẹ́sì, fóònù, ilé-ìwé, àkáǹtì ìkànnì àjọlò). Má ṣe béèrè wọn lọ́wọ́ àwọn òṣèré mìíràn láé.

pages.community.13.en: Before online play, the game asks for your year of birth (or uses the age range your phone's app store shares) and keeps only an age group, never the date.
pages.community.13.text: Ṣáájú eré orí ayélujára, eré náà ń béèrè ọdún ìbí rẹ (tàbí ó ń lo ìwọ̀n ọjọ́ orí tí ọjà àpù fóònù rẹ pín), ó sì ń pa ẹgbẹ́ ọjọ́ orí nìkan mọ́, kì í ṣe ọjọ́ náà láé.

pages.community.14.en: Players under 13 chat with ready-made messages only, keep the name the game gave them, and can be found only by friend code.
pages.community.14.text: Àwọn òṣèré tí kò tíì pé 13 ń bára sọ̀rọ̀ pẹ̀lú ọ̀rọ̀ tí a ti ṣe sílẹ̀ nìkan, wọ́n ń lo orúkọ tí eré fún wọn, a sì lè rí wọn nípasẹ̀ kóòdù ọ̀rẹ́ nìkan.

pages.community.15.en: Players aged 13 to 17 start hidden from strangers (only friends of friends can find them by name) and with their online status hidden; they can change this in Friends → Privacy. Offers never pop up for players under 18, and they have a monthly spending limit.
pages.community.15.text: Àwọn òṣèré ọmọ ọdún 13 sí 17 ń bẹ̀rẹ̀ ní fífarapamọ́ fún àjèjì (ọ̀rẹ́ àwọn ọ̀rẹ́ nìkan ló lè rí wọn nípa orúkọ) pẹ̀lú ipò orí ayélujára wọn ní fífarapamọ́; wọ́n lè yí èyí padà ní Ọ̀rẹ́ → Àṣírí. Ìfilọ̀ kì í yọ jáde fún àwọn òṣèré tí kò tíì pé 18 láé, wọ́n sì ní ààlà ìnáwó oṣooṣù.

pages.community.16.en: An age group can only be made stricter in the game. If it is wrong, contact support.
pages.community.16.text: A lè mú ẹgbẹ́ ọjọ́ orí le sí i nìkan nínú eré. Tí kò bá tọ́, kàn sí ìrànlọ́wọ́.

pages.community.18.en: No cheating: no modified games, bots, scripts or tools that play for you or change battles. Our server checks battles and refuses ones it cannot reproduce.
pages.community.18.text: Kò sí màgòmágó: kò sí eré tí a yí padà, rọ́bọ́ọ̀tì, ìwé-àṣẹ ẹ̀rọ tàbí irinṣẹ́ tí ń ṣeré fún ọ tàbí tí ń yí ogun padà. Sáfà wa ń ṣàyẹ̀wò ogun, ó sì ń kọ àwọn tí kò lè tún ṣe.

pages.community.19.en: Do not exploit bugs. Tell us about them instead ({t0}support{t1}).
pages.community.19.text: Má ṣe lo àṣìṣe eré ní ìlòkulò. Sọ fún wa nípa wọn dípò bẹ́ẹ̀ ({t0}ìrànlọ́wọ́{t1}).

pages.community.20.en: Do not buy, sell or share accounts, or trade game items for real money.
pages.community.20.text: Má ṣe rà, tà tàbí pín àkáǹtì, tàbí pààrọ̀ ohun inú eré fún owó gidi.

pages.community.21.en: Do not use other people's payment methods, or refund purchases you used in order to keep them.
pages.community.21.text: Má ṣe lo ọ̀nà ìsanwó ẹlòmíràn, tàbí béèrè ìdápadà owó fún rírà tí o ti lò kí o lè pa wọ́n mọ́.

pages.community.22.text: Tí nǹkan kan kò bá tọ́

pages.community.23.en: {t0}Block{t1}: tap {t2}⋯{t3} next to a message, a member or a friend card. You stop seeing their chat and requests at once, and they can no longer find you or send you friend requests.

pages.community.24.en: {t0}Report{t1}: from the same {t2}⋯{t3} menu, choose a reason and, if you like, add a note. A message reported by three different players is hidden for everyone until staff decide.

pages.community.26.text: Ohun tí àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ń ṣe

pages.community.27.en: Staff review reports and can remove messages, mute a player's chat and suspend accounts. Every staff action is logged. When we act, the player affected gets a message in the game (Settings → Online play → Account) saying what we decided, the reason and how to appeal, and everyone who reported it hears the outcome. If you think we got it wrong, write to {t0}{t1} with your Player ID and we will look again.
pages.community.27.text: Àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ń ṣàyẹ̀wò ẹ̀sùn, wọ́n sì lè yọ ọ̀rọ̀ kúrò, pa ìjíròrò òṣèré kan lẹ́nu mọ́ àti dá àkáǹtì dúró. A ń kọ gbogbo ìgbésẹ̀ òṣìṣẹ́ sílẹ̀. Nígbà tí a bá gbé ìgbésẹ̀, òṣèré tí ọ̀rọ̀ kàn ń gba ọ̀rọ̀ nínú eré (Ètò → Eré orí ayélujára → Àkáǹtì) tí ó sọ ohun tí a pinnu, ìdí rẹ̀ àti bí a ṣe lè bẹ̀bẹ̀ àtúnwò, gbogbo ẹni tí ó fi ẹ̀sùn kàn sì ń gbọ́ àbájáde rẹ̀. Tí o bá rò pé a ṣàṣìṣe, kọ̀wé sí {t0}{t1} pẹ̀lú ID Òṣèré rẹ, a ó sì tún un wò.

pages.community.28.en: The chat and name filters catch common bad words only; they cannot catch everything in every language. Reports and blocks are how players help us with the rest.
pages.community.28.text: Àwọn àṣẹ́ ìjíròrò àti orúkọ ń mú àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ burúkú tí ó wọ́pọ̀ nìkan; wọn kò lè mú gbogbo nǹkan ní gbogbo èdè. Ẹ̀sùn àti dídí ni ọ̀nà tí àwọn òṣèré ń gbà ràn wá lọ́wọ́ pẹ̀lú àwọn yòókù.

pages.terms.15.en: Jade does {t0}not expire{t1} while your account exists. Jade you buy and Jade you earn by playing share one balance. For records the law requires (for example in Japan), Jade earned in play counts as spent before Jade you bought.
pages.terms.15.text: Jéèdì {t0}kì í parí{t1} níwọ̀n ìgbà tí àkáǹtì rẹ bá wà. Jéèdì tí o rà àti Jéèdì tí o jèrè nípa ṣíṣeré ń pín iye kan. Fún àkọsílẹ̀ tí òfin béèrè (fún àpẹẹrẹ ní Japan), Jéèdì tí a jèrè nínú eré ni a kà sí èyí tí a kọ́kọ́ ná ṣáájú Jéèdì tí o rà.

pages.terms.16.en: Jade and items are {t0}non-refundable{t1}, except where the law requires a refund or the store you bought from grants one.
pages.terms.16.text: Jéèdì àti àwọn ohun {t0}kò ní ìdápadà owó{t1}, àyàfi níbi tí òfin bá béèrè ìdápadà tàbí tí ọjà tí o ti rà á bá fún ọ ní ọ̀kan.

pages.terms.17.en: If we close the game for good, we will announce it in the game at least 60 days before, stop selling Jade from the announcement, and refund unused purchased Jade where the law requires it.
pages.terms.17.text: Tí a bá ti eré náà pa títí láé, a ó kéde rẹ̀ nínú eré ó kéré tán ọjọ́ 60 ṣáájú, a ó dáwọ́ títà Jéèdì dúró láti ìgbà ìkéde náà, a ó sì dá owó Jéèdì tí a rà tí a kò lò padà níbi tí òfin bá béèrè rẹ̀.

pages.terms.18.en: We may change how items work or what they cost in Jade, for balance or fairness, but we will not take away items you bought except as these terms say (refunds, cheating, closing the game).
pages.terms.18.text: A lè yí bí àwọn ohun ṣe ń ṣiṣẹ́ padà tàbí iye Jéèdì tí wọ́n ń ná, fún ìwọ̀ntúnwọ̀nsì tàbí òdodo, ṣùgbọ́n a kò ní gba àwọn ohun tí o rà kúrò àyàfi bí àwọn òfin wọ̀nyí ṣe sọ (ìdápadà owó, màgòmágó, títi eré pa).

pages.terms.20.en: You buy through the App Store or Google Play, under their terms and with their payment methods. They show the final price in your currency, including taxes, before you pay, and they handle refunds.
pages.terms.20.text: O ń rà nípasẹ̀ App Store tàbí Google Play, lábẹ́ òfin wọn àti pẹ̀lú ọ̀nà ìsanwó wọn. Wọ́n ń fi iye owó ìkẹyìn hàn nínú owó orílẹ̀-èdè rẹ, pẹ̀lú owó-orí, kí o tó san, àwọn ló sì ń bójútó ìdápadà owó.

pages.terms.21.en: The game checks each purchase with the store before delivering it, delivers it once, and can restore it (Store → Restore purchases). If a store refunds or reverses a purchase, we can take back what it gave.
pages.terms.21.text: Eré náà ń ṣàyẹ̀wò rírà kọ̀ọ̀kan pẹ̀lú ọjà kí ó tó fi í jíṣẹ́, ó ń fi í jíṣẹ́ lẹ́ẹ̀kan, ó sì lè dá a padà (Ọjà → Dá àwọn rírà padà). Tí ọjà kan bá dá owó rírà padà tàbí yí i padà, a lè gba ohun tí ó fúnni padà.

pages.terms.22.en: The Season Scroll's premium track lasts until the end of the season it was bought in. Limited-time offers end at the time shown; their deadlines are real.
pages.terms.22.text: Ọ̀nà ẹ̀bùn àkànṣe Ìwé-àkájọ Àsìkò ń wà títí di òpin àsìkò tí a rà á. Ìfilọ̀ onígbà díẹ̀ ń parí ní àkókò tí a fi hàn; àkókò ìparí wọn jẹ́ òótọ́.

pages.terms.23.en: Players under 18 have a monthly spending limit and an extra confirmation step. They do not get offers that open on their own.
pages.terms.23.text: Àwọn òṣèré tí kò tíì pé 18 ní ààlà ìnáwó oṣooṣù àti ìgbésẹ̀ ìfìdímúlẹ̀ àfikún. Wọn kì í gba ìfilọ̀ tí ń ṣí fúnra rẹ̀.

pages.terms.24.en: Nothing random is sold. The only random reward, the daily chest, is free and shows its odds before it opens.
pages.terms.24.text: A kì í ta ohunkóhun tí ó jẹ́ láìròtẹ́lẹ̀. Ẹ̀bùn àìròtẹ́lẹ̀ kan ṣoṣo, àpótí ojoojúmọ́, jẹ́ ọ̀fẹ́, ó sì ń fi àǹfààní rẹ̀ hàn kí ó tó ṣí.

pages.terms.25.en: Where the law gives you a right to withdraw from a purchase of digital content (for example in the EU and UK), it ends when the content is delivered to your account, if you asked for immediate delivery and acknowledged that you lose the right. This does not affect your rights if the content is faulty.
pages.terms.25.text: Níbi tí òfin bá fún ọ ní ẹ̀tọ́ láti yọ̀ kúrò nínú rírà ohun oní-nọ́ńbà (fún àpẹẹrẹ ní EU àti UK), ó ń parí nígbà tí a bá fi ohun náà jíṣẹ́ sí àkáǹtì rẹ, tí o bá béèrè ìfijíṣẹ́ lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀ tí o sì gbà pé o pàdánù ẹ̀tọ́ náà. Èyí kò kan ẹ̀tọ́ rẹ tí ohun náà bá ní àbùkù.

pages.terms.26.text: 5. Bí o ṣe yẹ kí o hùwà

pages.terms.28.text: 6. Ohun tí o kọ àti tí o ṣẹ̀dá

pages.terms.29.en: You keep the rights in what you write or create in the game (player name, chat messages, Gang and Alliance names, village layouts). The licence ends when you or we delete it, except for copies kept for the periods in the privacy policy (for example a reported message kept as evidence). Do not post anything you have no right to share. We do not check chat before it is sent: a word filter catches common words, and players can report and block.
pages.terms.29.text: O ń pa ẹ̀tọ́ mọ́ nínú ohun tí o kọ tàbí tí o ṣẹ̀dá nínú eré (orúkọ òṣèré, ọ̀rọ̀ ìjíròrò, orúkọ Ẹgbẹ́ àti Àjọṣepọ̀, ìlànà abúlé). Má ṣe fi ohunkóhun tí o kò ní ẹ̀tọ́ láti pín síta. A kì í ṣàyẹ̀wò ìjíròrò kí a tó fi ránṣẹ́: àṣẹ́ ọ̀rọ̀ ń mú àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ tí ó wọ́pọ̀, àwọn òṣèré sì lè fi ẹ̀sùn kàn kí wọ́n sì dí ènìyàn.

pages.terms.31.en: We can remove messages or names, mute chat, and suspend or close accounts that break these terms or the community rules, or to protect players or comply with the law. A message reported by three different players is hidden automatically until staff decide.
pages.terms.31.text: A lè yọ ọ̀rọ̀ tàbí orúkọ kúrò, pa ìjíròrò lẹ́nu mọ́, kí a sì dá àkáǹtì dúró tàbí tì í pa tí ó bá rú àwọn òfin wọ̀nyí tàbí òfin àwùjọ, tàbí láti dáàbò bo àwọn òṣèré tàbí láti tẹ̀lé òfin. Ọ̀rọ̀ tí òṣèré mẹ́ta ọ̀tọ̀ọ̀tọ̀ fi ẹ̀sùn kàn ni a ń fi pamọ́ láìfọwọ́yí títí àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ yóò fi pinnu.

pages.terms.32.en: When we act against your content or account, we tell you in the game what we did, why, and for how long, unless the law or a player's safety prevents it. When you report something, we tell you what we decided.
pages.terms.32.text: Nígbà tí a bá gbé ìgbésẹ̀ lórí ohun tí o kọ tàbí àkáǹtì rẹ, a ń sọ fún ọ nínú eré ohun tí a ṣe, ìdí rẹ̀, àti bí ó ṣe pẹ́ tó, àyàfi tí òfin tàbí ààbò òṣèré kan bá dí i lọ́wọ́. Nígbà tí o bá fi ẹ̀sùn kan nǹkan kan, a ń sọ ohun tí a pinnu fún ọ.

pages.terms.35.text: O lè dúró nígbàkúùgbà kí o sì pa àkáǹtì orí ayélujára rẹ rẹ́ (Ètò → Eré orí ayélujára → Àkáǹtì, tàbí fọ́ọ̀mù wẹ́ẹ̀bù nínú ìlànà àṣírí).

pages.terms.36.en: We can suspend or close an account for serious or repeated breaches, cheating, fraud, payment abuse or legal reasons. A suspension for a breach does not entitle you to a refund, except where the law requires one.
pages.terms.36.text: A lè dá àkáǹtì dúró tàbí tì í pa fún ìrúfin tí ó le tàbí tí ó ń wáyé léraléra, màgòmágó, jìbìtì, ìlòkulò ìsanwó tàbí ìdí òfin. Ìdádúró fún ìrúfin kò fún ọ ní ẹ̀tọ́ sí ìdápadà owó, àyàfi níbi tí òfin bá béèrè ọ̀kan.

pages.account.4.en: Open {t0}Settings → Online play → Account → Delete online account{t1}. Your online account is deleted at once. This works even if you switched to {t2}Play offline{t3}: the game connects just to delete it.
pages.account.4.text: Ṣí {t0}Ètò → Eré orí ayélujára → Àkáǹtì → Pa àkáǹtì orí ayélujára rẹ́{t1}. A ó pa àkáǹtì orí ayélujára rẹ rẹ́ lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀. Èyí ń ṣiṣẹ́ kódà tí o bá ti yí padà sí {t2}Ṣeré láìsí ayélujára{t3}: eré náà ń sopọ̀ kìkì láti pa á rẹ́.

pages.account.5.text: Ohun tí a ń pa rẹ́

pages.account.6.en: Your player name and online account, the base you shared for raids, and your village if it is kept on our server.
pages.account.6.text: Orúkọ òṣèré rẹ àti àkáǹtì orí ayélujára rẹ, ibùdó tí o pín fún ìgbógunti, àti abúlé rẹ tí a bá ń tọ́jú rẹ̀ sórí sáfà wa.

pages.account.7.en: Your friends and friend requests, your Gang membership and your linked sign-ins.
pages.account.7.text: Àwọn ọ̀rẹ́ rẹ àti ìbéèrè ọ̀rẹ́, ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ Ẹgbẹ́ rẹ àti ọ̀nà ìwọlé tí o so.

pages.account.8.en: Raids on your village, your Alliance membership, your chat messages, warrior requests and warriors sent to you.
pages.account.8.text: Ìgbógunti sí abúlé rẹ, ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ Àjọṣepọ̀ rẹ, ọ̀rọ̀ ìjíròrò rẹ, ìbéèrè jagunjagun àti jagunjagun tí a fi ránṣẹ́ sí ọ.

pages.account.9.text: Ohun tí àwọn òṣèré mìíràn ń pa mọ́

pages.account.10.en: Replays of raids you made stay with the players you raided, shown as "Deleted player". Warriors you sent and Alliance War results stay the same way, without your name.
pages.account.10.text: Àtúnwò ìgbógunti tí o ṣe ń wà lọ́dọ̀ àwọn òṣèré tí o gbógun tì, tí a fi hàn bí "Òṣèré tí a pa rẹ́". Jagunjagun tí o fi ránṣẹ́ àti àbájáde Ogun Àjọṣepọ̀ ń wà bákan náà, láìsí orúkọ rẹ.

pages.account.11.en: Copies of your base in other players' recent battles are removed within 30 days.
pages.account.11.text: A ń yọ ẹ̀dà ibùdó rẹ nínú àwọn ogun àìpẹ́ àwọn òṣèré mìíràn kúrò láàrin ọjọ́ 30.

pages.account.12.en: A village saved on your device stays there: to remove it, uninstall the app, or clear the game site's data in your browser. Purchase records are kept without your Player ID, as tax and refund rules require.
pages.account.12.text: Abúlé tí a fi pamọ́ sórí ẹ̀rọ rẹ ń wà níbẹ̀: láti yọ ọ́ kúrò, yọ àpù náà kúrò, tàbí pa dátà ojú-òpó eré náà rẹ́ nínú aṣàwákiri rẹ. A ń pa àkọsílẹ̀ rírà mọ́ láìsí ID Òṣèré rẹ, gẹ́gẹ́ bí òfin owó-orí àti ìdápadà owó ṣe béèrè.

pages.account.14.en: Other players can see Player IDs, so we need proof that the account is yours: a {t0}deletion code{t1}. Get one in the game under {t2}Settings → Online play → Account → Get a deletion code{t3} (it works once, for 30 days), then send it here with your Player ID from the same screen. Staff delete a request with a valid code within 30 days, usually much sooner.
pages.account.14.text: Àwọn òṣèré mìíràn ń rí ID Òṣèré, nítorí náà a nílò ẹ̀rí pé àkáǹtì náà jẹ́ tìrẹ: {t0}kóòdù ìparẹ́{t1}. Gba ọ̀kan nínú eré ní {t2}Ètò → Eré orí ayélujára → Àkáǹtì → Gba kóòdù ìparẹ́{t3} (ó ń ṣiṣẹ́ lẹ́ẹ̀kan, fún ọjọ́ 30), lẹ́yìn náà fi í ránṣẹ́ síbí pẹ̀lú ID Òṣèré rẹ láti ojú-ìwé kan náà. Àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ń pa ìbéèrè tí ó ní kóòdù tí ó tọ́ rẹ́ láàrin ọjọ́ 30, nígbà púpọ̀ ṣáájú ìgbà náà.

pages.account.15.en: No code, and you can't open the game any more? Send your Player ID anyway and contact support from the game's support page with the reference you get: we can only delete the account once we can confirm it is yours (for example through the Apple, Google or Game Center sign-in linked to it, or a store receipt). We don't ask for an email address here.
pages.account.15.text: Kò sí kóòdù, o kò sì lè ṣí eré náà mọ́? Fi ID Òṣèré rẹ ránṣẹ́ bákan náà kí o sì kàn sí ìrànlọ́wọ́ láti ojú-ìwé ìrànlọ́wọ́ eré náà pẹ̀lú nọ́mbà ìtọ́kasí tí o gbà: a lè pa àkáǹtì náà rẹ́ kìkì ní kété tí a bá lè fìdí rẹ̀ múlẹ̀ pé ó jẹ́ tìrẹ (fún àpẹẹrẹ nípasẹ̀ ìwọlé Apple, Google tàbí Game Center tí a so mọ́ ọn, tàbí ìwé-ẹ̀rí ọjà). A kò béèrè àdírẹ́sì ímeèlì níbí.

pages.account.17.en: Deletion code {t0}(from Settings → Online play → Account){t1}
pages.account.17.text: Kóòdù ìparẹ́ {t0}(láti Ètò → Eré orí ayélujára → Àkáǹtì){t1}

pages.account.18.en: Anything else {t0}(optional; please don't include contact details){t1}
pages.account.18.text: Ohunkóhun mìíràn {t0}(kò pọn dandan; jọ̀wọ́ má ṣe fi àlàyé ìbánisọ̀rọ̀ kún un){t1}

pages.account.20.en: Enter your Player ID (Settings → Online play → Account).
pages.account.20.text: Tẹ ID Òṣèré rẹ (Ètò → Eré orí ayélujára → Àkáǹtì).

pages.account.22.en: The request did not go through. Try again later.
pages.account.22.text: Ìbéèrè náà kò ṣeé ṣe. Gbìyànjú lẹ́yìn náà.

pages.account.23.en: Request received and confirmed with your code. Your reference:
pages.account.23.text: A ti gba ìbéèrè náà, a sì ti fìdí rẹ̀ múlẹ̀ pẹ̀lú kóòdù rẹ. Nọ́mbà ìtọ́kasí rẹ:

pages.account.24.en: Request received, but without a valid deletion code we cannot confirm the account is yours. Your reference:
pages.account.24.text: A ti gba ìbéèrè náà, ṣùgbọ́n láìsí kóòdù ìparẹ́ tí ó tọ́, a kò lè fìdí rẹ̀ múlẹ̀ pé àkáǹtì náà jẹ́ tìrẹ. Nọ́mbà ìtọ́kasí rẹ:

pages.account.25.en: . Get a code in the game, or contact support with this reference.
pages.account.25.text: . Gba kóòdù nínú eré, tàbí kàn sí ìrànlọ́wọ́ pẹ̀lú nọ́mbà ìtọ́kasí yìí.
